Hello,
Sorry for my late reply. I can see that the charger is currently green and functioning without any issues.
Did the reduced power delivery occur recently? In the session you reported, the issue was caused by a miscommunication between the PLC and one of the converters. However, all converters are now properly connected.
Let me know if you need any further information or support.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL
